budget_issue: The first observed start was 23:52:51Z and the report hash readback completed at 23:56:06Z, beyond the hard three-minute budget. This overrun is disclosed; returning without further investigation.
authority: Only the seven new unversioned-factory ownership/sharing increment files. Existing product 355 and prior SPECQUALITY approvals are not reopened. The sole authorized write is this new review JSON; no source fix, original-test edit, commit, push, signing, native-init change or secret-value access.
spec_sources: Delegated task and exact seven-file scope supplied by parent/user

verified_invariants.basis: Reviewer extracted original HEAD wearChannel body and moved wearCompat body independently; byte equality and pinned original hash both match. All APIs, bounds, callback generation guards, diagnostics, summary, READY/SEND_206/207 and close behavior remain in the complete body.
Original wearChannel prefix/version branch matches byte-for-byte except the additive compat import. Only the previous unversioned body becomes return compat(identity, protocol, engine).

app.js adds only import and lazy three-argument wrapper. Source and packed-bridge tests retain literal identity/protocol/engine object references; no native import/init in compat or new app wrapper. Packed bridge explicitly resolves $app.$def||$app and missing owner returns APP_COMPAT_UNAVAILABLE without local factory fallback.

Packer requires unique marker/API-bearing three-argument factory in each app/page webpack candidate, compares entire cleaned factory AST, rejects compat native initialization, and preserves page prefix/suffix and all non-target HAP/APP payload bytes. Current fixture app bundle is unchanged. Two separately proven missing fail-closed assertions are listed below.

git diff HEAD lists no changed original tests, config identity or original verification/final_gate files. Workflow is exactly its HEAD bytes plus one share step after compact_lite_app and before compact_p2p_page/verification/signing. Existing byte/native/signature/failure-only gates remain complete.

findings.requirement: The app owner must actually link/delegate to the entire original factory; packing must fail closed for missing/drifted app ownership.
findings.finding: ownerHas only finds an _elctonWearCompat property and any require(target) anywhere in the same webpack module. It does not prove that this property's value or wrapper invokes that factory. A disconnected owner is accepted and appSourceMethodHas is reported true, so factory AST equality alone does not protect dispatch.
findings.independent_reproduction: Synthetic QA app changed _elctonWearCompat:require("compat").default to _elctonWearCompat:function(){return {};},unrelated:require("compat").default, retaining identical complete page/app factories. shareCompatApp accepted the input and reported appSourceMethodHas:true. This is a gate defect, not a claim that the present app.js wrapper is disconnected.
findings.minimal_resolution: Validate the actual _elctonWearCompat property value/wrapper and its dependency linkage to the selected factory, including three-argument delegation, rather than two independent module-wide booleans. Add a disconnected-owner negative case only to the new sharing test.
findings.verification: The reproduced disconnected-owner fixture must reject; present lazy wrapper and existing positive ownership fixtures must continue to pass. No old tests or gates need edits.

findings.requirement: Preserve includeSources for every original module and fail closed rather than attest missing module-source content.
findings.finding: updateMap validates only array existence/equal lengths; null source content is accepted and re-appended verbatim while sourceMapIncludeSources is unconditionally true. Thus the claimed per-original-module includeSources invariant is not enforced. The added whole input-bundle source is not the missing original module source.
findings.independent_reproduction: Synthetic QA map {version:3,sources:["webpack:///compat.js"],sourcesContent:[null],names:[],mappings:""} was accepted; shareCompatApp reported sourceMapIncludeSources:true. No actual SDK input or source map was fabricated or changed.
findings.minimal_resolution: Require actual string sourcesContent entries for each original source before claiming includeSources, preserving all original source strings exactly. Add this negative case to the new test; retain existing mapped sources and byte-parity guards.
findings.verification: A null/missing original module content fixture must reject or return a non-passing verified invariant, while complete includeSources inputs retain their original sources/content pairs.

native_boundary.basis: Existing actual SDK/QEMU failure evidence only. New actual SDK artifact plus unchanged exact-native CI gate/readback is still required. Local green source/synthetic tests do not prove parse OOM repaired, watch heap safety or WE handshake. Moving parse ownership to app is a strategy, not measured memory success. Image/audio/UI/device profile are unchanged and out of this increment's scope.

disposition: BLOCKED only on two reproduced fail-closed packaging assertion gaps in the new scope. Present source factory move is byte-identical, lazy wrapper and literal injected references are correct, old version routing/identity/tests/gates remain intact. No functional deletion or gate reduction found. Fix the two smallest new packer/new-test checks, rebind hashes and re-review the increment; do not reopen product baseline or claim actual SDK parse success.
